            temp_densities.append(d)

            temp_densities = [d]

        unique_dens.append(np.mean(temp_densities))
    
    temps = np.array(unique_temps)
    dens = np.array(unique_dens)

            slope_high, intercept_high, r_high, _, _ = stats.linregress(high_temp, high_dens)
            slope_low, intercept_low, r_low, _, _ = stats.linregress(low_temp, low_dens)
            
            # Calculate R² sum (quality of both fits)
            r2_sum = r_high**2 + r_low**2

            slope_diff = abs(slope_high - slope_low)
